summary: Radiopharm Theranostics Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing an ASX announcement dated October 5, 2026, disclosing completion of an End-of-Phase 2 meeting with the US FDA for RAD101, a Fluorine-18-labeled FASN-targeting imaging agent for detecting recurrent brain metastases. Prior Phase 2b data showed 93% concordance with MRI, meeting the primary endpoint. Official FDA meeting minutes are expected within roughly 30 days. No price, stake, premium, or transaction terms were stated. The company is undertaking Phase 3 readiness activities and evaluating strategic-partner engagement; no board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch the minutes for pivotal-trial design requirements.
